tasks.title: G4 Undo as a request with opponent consent
tasks.description: Human-vs-human: POST /api/undo records state.undoRequest instead of mutating; POST /api/undo/respond {consent} from the opponent applies/clears it. Consent holds for the whole game (both seats occupied by humans, expiry-independent). A finished game rejects all undo actions 409 'game over'; draw-claim/draw-accept/timeout clear the pending request. Solo/bot/unseated undo unchanged. g4-undo-request-selftest (76 assertions).

tasks.title: A2.2 Study chapters — PGN/FEN/game import + hidden-move quiz + NAG PGN export
tasks.description: New #/study view plus /api/study/*: three chapter kinds (PGN parsed by study-tree.fromPGN preserving RAV + NAGs, FEN validated server-side with a recorded line, archived game by id). Hidden-move quiz mode guesses two-click on the Study board; POST /api/study/:id/guess validates against the stored line server-side (alternate mates accepted, wrong guesses never leak the solution, scripted replies auto-play). GET /api/study/:id/pgn exports PGN via study-tree.toPGN with $1-$9 NAG glyphs that round-trip through fromPGN. study-store.js mirrors social-store.js (CHESS_STUDY_DB_PATH / CHESS_STUDY_JSON_PATH). study-tree.js leaves KNOWN_DARK (now required from server.js). test/study-chapters-selftest.js (17) + test/study-tree-selftest.js (49).
